timestamp_rules: 380 local kickoff clocks have no independently verified timezone; date-only or local clocks never become exact UTC timestamps.
Relative period clocks are source evidence, not absolute event/publication times.
Identity, native-to-market meanings, completeness, corrections and settlement remain unqualified. No missing measurement is treated as zero.
Later acquisition does not become pre-match knowledge. Historical labels require a separately approved chronological use; own-target feature use stays prohibited.
period_definition: Native periods 1 and 2 and relative clocks are retained; no absolute event timestamp or settlement-compatible score is inferred.

target_semantic_checks.basis: UNQUALIFIED; source pairs do not by themselves bind regulation versus extra time
target_semantic_checks.completeness: 380 paired source values; no canonical qualification

target_semantic_checks.basis: MISSING_PROOF; no score reconstructed from incomplete event meanings
Native Shot count only; target completeness and inclusion rules unqualified
MISSING_PROOF; Saved Off Target cannot establish on-target settlement equivalence
MISSING_PROOF; second-yellow/red and team/player settlement meanings unqualified

correction_handling: Original source hashes stay frozen; a corrected score requires new retained bytes and an append-only source/identity/target decision. No later value overwrites the original.
missingness: Absent/unknown/unsupported counts remain absent. Native observed zero is distinct from missing.
historical_use: Later-acquired labels are not previously known features; own-target post-event use is prohibited. No chronological training/evaluation protocol is granted.
